emails.subject_line_a: Quick build for Davis Roofing Solutions
emails.body_text:
Hey Drew,

I was checking out davisroofingsolutions.com — strong DFW reputation, especially the straight-shooter approach to honest inspections.

One conversion leak jumped out on mobile: your homepage and contact page both ask homeowners to fill out a 13-field form 'as detailed as possible' before seeing any rough price range.

So I built a working 30-second DFW Roof Estimator in your exact blue-and-amber Davis Roofing Solutions colors. Homeowners tap their roof specs and see an instant ballpark before leaving their name and number.

Mind if I send over the live preview link?

— {{sender_name}}

{{sender_address}} | {{unsubscribe_line}}

objection_handlers.objection: Our reps need detailed info before calling — that's why our form has 13 fields.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: That makes total sense — and this actually gives your reps better info than a blank text box. Instead of forcing homeowners to type paragraphs on a phone, 4 visual taps automatically capture roof sq. ft., stories, slope, material preference, and hail urgency while doubling form completion.

objection_handlers.objection: Every DFW roof is different — I don't want homeowners holding us to an online number.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: 100% agree — it never quotes a binding price. It shows a realistic DFW ballpark range with a clear on-site inspection disclaimer so low-ball shoppers filter themselves out while serious homeowners book already expecting $13k–$40k+.

objection_handlers.objection: Why spend $750 setup + $149/mo when we already have a website agency?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Most agencies charge $5k+ for full site rebuilds and still stick a static form on the page. This is a focused $750 drop-in conversion tool your web team pastes in 5 minutes, includes quarterly DFW pricing updates and instant CRM routing, and pays for itself 3+ years over with one closed job.
